system.description:
[Trigger: Action & Fate 1] This is used simultaneously with the [Ranged Attack] made by this weapon. The attack range is increased by +1Sq. [Trigger: Minor] This is used when the target of the [Ranged Attack] made by this weapon becomes [Incapacitated]. The target cannot use actions or effects that would normally be available. This effect is treated as an [Seal] tagged LS, and can be dispelled by consuming 2 points of [Fate]. A magic crossbow that fires amethyst bolts. Infusing it with magic increases its range, and it carries a curse that seals abilities triggered by a foe's desperate counterattack or death, so it is used in named and raid battles to finish off minions with troublesome abilities.

Crystal Casket [Core Material] (240G) + Repeater (510G) + Oblivion Poison (Intermediate) (60G) ×5 + [Magic Catalyst 12] (150G) ×4 + Crafting Cost (660G)
